blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Let the Asian Games begin. Team Philippines officially opened its Aichi-Nagoya campaign after parading at Paloma Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in the opening ceremony on Saturday. Weightlifter Albert Ian Delos Santos and Olympic bronze medalist boxer Aira Villegas carried the flag during the parade. The Philippines–the 30th entry during the customary Parade of Nations–was represented by athletes, coaches, and sports officials during the vibrant opening spectacle. The majority of the tournaments open on Sunday, but Team Philippines is already assured a breakthrough medal in soft tennis […]...
